title: HECM Prepayments: Application to the Balance and Restoration of the Line
content:
**Right to prepay.** A borrower may prepay any part of the balance of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) at any time without penalty, per the plan's prepayment penalty rate. A prepayment is applied only while the loan status is active, deferral period or due and payable.

**Order of application.** A partial prepayment is applied in the plan's allocation order: first to outstanding mortgage insurance premium, then to outstanding servicing fees, then to outstanding interest, and the rest to principal. Each component takes the lesser of the remittance still unapplied and that component's outstanding amount, and one portion is posted per component that receives a positive amount, all dated the day the funds were received. For this purpose:

- outstanding premium is every premium accrual over the life of the loan up to and including the handling date, less prepaid portions applied to premium;
- outstanding servicing fees are every servicing fee and plan change fee, less reversals of those fees, less prepaid portions applied to servicing fees;
- outstanding interest is every interest accrual, less prepaid portions applied to interest.

**Payoff boundary.** A remittance equal to or larger than the whole loan balance is not a partial prepayment and is handled as a payoff under the payoff charter. Installments remitted under a property-charge repayment plan are applied the same way, each portion referencing the installment.

**Restoration of the line.** On plans whose prepaid amounts are credited back to the available line, and while the loan status is active, every prepaid portion posts as restoring the line and the same amount is credited back to the available line on the same date as one line restoration entry referencing that portion. *Retired, no longer in force and superseded by the current basis:* the clause that on the fixed-rate single disbursement plan, and on any loan that is due and payable or in the deferral period, a prepaid portion restores nothing to the line and nothing is restored.

*Hypothetical:* a 500.00 remittance on an active loan owing 20.00 premium, 0.00 fees and 100.00 interest posts portions of 20.00, 100.00 and 380.00 to premium, interest and principal, and each portion is credited back to the available line the same day.

superseded_clauses: on the fixed-rate single disbursement plan, and on any loan that is due_and_payable or in the deferral period, restores_line is false and nothing is restored.
